en-US.description: Remote desktop and remote support for IT professionals
en-US.longDescription: AskClyde is a remote desktop and remote support tool for IT professionals. It provides attended (QuickSupport) and unattended (Windows service) remote control with hardware-accelerated H.264 video, file transfer, chat, voice, session recording, an address book with health monitoring (NOC dashboard), AI-assisted troubleshooting, enterprise audit logging and cross-platform hosts on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android.
en-US.name: AskClyde
